results.source_quote: All systems must enforce role-based access control policies.
results.description: Systems must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict user access based on assigned roles.

results.source_quote: Multi-factor authentication shall be required for all privileged accounts.
results.description: Privileged accounts require multi-factor authentication (MFA) to prevent unauthorized access.

results.source_quote: Organizations shall maintain audit logs for all system events for a minimum of 90 days.
results.description: Audit logs covering all system events must be retained for at least 90 days.
